headword: {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}

definitions.explanation: The most common type of business corporation in Japan, equivalent to a limited company or corporation. Abbreviated as (株) in company names.

examples.japanese: {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}した。
{彼|かれ}は{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}ABCの{社長|しゃちょう}です。
examples.english: He is the president of ABC Corporation.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}で{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}を{作|つく}るには、{資本金|しほんきん}が{一円|いちえん}から{可能|かのう}になった。
examples.english: In Japan, it has become possible to create a corporation with as little as one yen in capital.

notes: Often abbreviated as ({株|かぶ}) in written contexts, placed either before or after the company name: {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}トヨタ or トヨタ{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}. The position (before or after) is determined by the company's official registration. Other Japanese corporate forms include {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ} (LLC, abbreviated {合|ごう}), {合資会社|ごうしがいしゃ} (limited partnership), and {合名会社|ごうめいがいしゃ} (general partnership). Colloquially often shortened to {株|かぶ} when referring to shares or the stock market.
